items.question: ok and how does this connect to congestion avoidance?

oracle.expected_behavior_note: Continuing from the slow start explanation: slow start hands over to congestion avoidance when cwnd reaches ssthresh (16 segments in the lecture's trace; the course's clamp rule stops slow start from overshooting it). From then on the window grows by one segment per round instead of doubling. A loss ties the two together again: after three duplicate ACKs ssthresh and cwnd are both set to half and the sender stays in congestion avoidance; after a timeout ssthresh is halved and the sender returns to slow start from the initial window.

required_facts.text: Slow start ends, and congestion avoidance begins, when cwnd reaches ssthresh.
In congestion avoidance the window grows additively, one segment per round, instead of doubling.

optional_facts.text: +1 is per round (per RTT), not per ACK.
After a timeout the sender goes back to slow start from the initial window with ssthresh halved.
After three duplicate ACKs cwnd is set to the halved ssthresh and congestion avoidance continues.
Clamp rule: next cwnd = min(2 x cwnd, ssthresh).

forbidden_claims.text: Loses the thread and answers as if 'this' were something other than slow start.
Says congestion avoidance adds one segment per ACK.
